subject.title: fix(nextcloud-talk): reject oversized API password files

question: Should Nextcloud Talk adopt the shared 16 KiB credential-file limit as an unconditional fail-closed upgrade behavior for apiPasswordFile?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but it deliberately invalidates a file shape that previous releases read without a bound; accepting that compatibility tightening is a maintainer policy choice.

options.title: Accept the shared limit
options.body: Adopt the 16 KiB credential boundary, retain the submitted compatibility tests, refresh the branch, and merge the security hardening.

options.title: Pause for another policy
options.body: Do not merge until maintainers define a different channel-specific size or diagnostic contract for oversized API password files.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared limit
recommendation.body: Adopt the 16 KiB credential boundary, retain the submitted compatibility tests, refresh the branch, and merge the security hardening.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior shipped work is directly tied to the shared secret-file fail-closed contract this PR adopts.
